title.narrative: ''Supporting sustainable coffee production and the conservation of forest ecosystems through climate-relevant and integrated landscape management of the Yayu Coffee Forest Biosphere Reserve.

description.narrative: The action is implemented in Yayu Coffee Forest Biosphere Reserve (YCFBR) Oromia Region; Ilu Aba Bora and BunnoBedeleZones Woreda covered: Yayu, Hurumu, Dorani, Alge-sachi,Bilo-Nophaworedas,Chora.
